description: Development toolchain, kept out of the module's own composer.json on purpose.
//: The module's vendor/ is committed and deployed verbatim (a REDCap EM deploys by directory
copy), so it must never contain a test framework. Keeping PHPUnit here rather than in
require-dev makes that structural instead of procedural: the module has no dev
dependencies at all, so `composer install` in the module root cannot produce a tree that
differs from what ships, and nobody can commit PHPUnit to production by forgetting a flag.
Install with `composer test:install` from the module root. tools/vendor is gitignored.
